Our true labels are $$y=(0, 0, 1), $$ our predicted probabilities of being in class $$1$$ are $$(0.1, 0.6, 0.9), $$ and our threshold is $$T=0.5.$$
A third loss function we might consider is the zero-one loss, given by
$$L_{ZO}(y,\hat{y})=I(y
eq\hat{y})$$
In other words, the loss is $$1$$ if the label is incorrect, and $$0$$ if it is correct. For these same values, what is the total zero-one loss?
